name: Fiji Citizenship by Registration, Marriage Ground

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign spouse of a Fiji citizen.

3 of the preceding 5 years lawful presence, under the 2026 Act's transitional schedule (running through 2030). English-language requirement is waived for spousal registration, unlike the ordinary naturalisation track.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of lawful presence within a 5-year window.

evidence_required.document: Proof of lawful presence 3 of the preceding 5 years

sources.title: Fiji High Commission, New Zealand -- Fiji Citizenship: registration for a foreign spouse of a Fiji citizen requires 3 of the preceding 5 years lawful presence under the 2026 Act's transitional schedule (through 2030), thereafter also requiring a PR permit; English-language requirement waived for spousal registration

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced via a Fiji diplomatic mission page. Gender-neutral: no gendered language found distinguishing a foreign wife from a foreign husband of a Fiji citizen. Notably more generous than fj_citizenship_naturalisation.json on the language requirement (English waived here) but similar on the underlying years-of-presence test. Like the naturalisation route, this is on a transitional schedule -- through 2030, per the source -- after which a PR permit becomes an additional precondition; the post-2030 rule's exact terms were not independently confirmed in this pass, only that a PR-permit requirement is expected to apply, mirroring the naturalisation route's 2035 transition.
